svg.title: Lasik palette on OBSIDIAN
svg.desc: The Lasik scale: every hue in steps 50 (lightest) to 950 (darkest), with each color's hex value and its contrast ratio against the OBSIDIAN background #01030a. A star marks each hue's hand-picked base color.
svg.text: contrast against OBSIDIAN #01030a · red = below 4.5:1 (WCAG AA for text) · ★ hand-picked
600 and lighter: text (AA). 500 and lighter: High Contrast text (AAA). 700: borders (3:1). 800 and darker: backgrounds.
